channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Supreme Court Verdict Redefines Aravalli Hills: Key Changes, Impacts & What It Means for the Environment | Explained
item.description: The Supreme Court's 100-metre elevation rule could strip legal protection from 90% of the Aravalli hills. Read in detail.

item.title: Assam Rewards Blind World Cup Star Simu Das With Government Job, Signals Shift in Para-Sports Recognition
item.description: Assam rewards Simu Das, B1 blind cricket World Cup hero, with a government instructor role, boosting para-sports visibility after Rs 10 lakh support.

item.title: Six Thalassaemia Children Contract HIV from Contaminated Blood Transfusions in Madhya Pradesh Hospital Probe
item.description: Six Satna thalassaemia kids test HIV+ post-transfusions; blood bank suspensions, probes ignite outrage.

item.title: ‘Save Aravalli’ Trends as Mass Protests Erupt in North India Over Supreme Court Ruling
item.description: Protests surge as India’s oldest mountain range faces a "death warrant" from a new 100-metre height rule.

item.title: Hindu Garment Worker Beaten to Death, Body Burnt in Bangladesh Over Alleged Blasphemy, Police Call It Heinous
item.description: A 28‑year‑old Hindu garment worker in Mymensingh was lynched by a mob over alleged blasphemy, his body later tied to a tree and burned, deepening fears among Bangladesh’s religious minorities.

item.title: RBI Fines Kotak Mahindra Bank ₹61.95 Lakh for Regulatory Lapses in Accounts, Reporting
item.description: RBI fined Kotak Mahindra Bank over sixty-one lakh rupees for violating basic savings account and reporting regulations.

item.title: Massive Khanpora Landslide Triggers Panic in Baramulla Amid Illegal Stone Quarrying Fears on 19 December
item.description: A Khanpora landslide caused by illegal quarrying sparked panic in foggy Baramulla but was contained by swift police action with no casualties.

item.title: Delhi Education Minister Announces Tenders for 10,000 Air Purifiers in Schools Amid Severe AQI 442 Pollution Crisis for Students
item.description: Delhi's government has issued tenders for air purifiers in 10,000 school classrooms to combat severe winter pollution threatening students' health, marking a shift to long-term reforms.

item.title: Delhi Fog Alert: Over 129 Flights Cancelled As Toxic Smog Blinds National Capital Region
item.description: Over 129 flights were cancelled in Delhi on Saturday as extreme fog and toxic smog crippled transport.

item.title: Gujarat Electoral Roll Overhaul: Nearly 74 Lakh Deleted After SIR, EC Opens Window for Objections
item.description: Gujarat electoral rolls see record 7.37 million deletions to ensure transparency and remove duplicate or deceased voters, as per ECI.
